title: The container's run-epic resolves the compiled-in local-subprocess profiles, so every cloud worker runs inside the orchestrator container
body: The staged entrypoint (internal/factory/ticfacentrypoint.go) execs ticfac run-epic with no --profiles, so profiles/ (executor local-subprocess) is resolved and the cloud overlay only swaps the runner to pi; internal/cli knownExecutors/executorFactory do not know cloudflare-sandbox, so profiles-cloudflare-sandbox/ would be refused anyway. xte's core clause (one sandbox per tick, no worker in the orchestrator's container) needs the executor registered, collect/cancel/dispose decided (a35ff202, a69a9747), and the container pointed at the cloud profile set, with a test that the STAGED entrypoint resolves executor cloudflare-sandbox.
